title: High Volume, Bandwidth Heavy Infrastructure On The Cheap - Kyle Drake
summary: Kyle Drake of Neocities explains the bandwidth pricing pitfalls of the big cloud providers. He describes how to run high-volume, bandwidth-heavy infrastructure far more cheaply, including through co-location.
why: HN recommends it whenever cloud egress costs come up, since it gives concrete numbers on real bandwidth costs versus cloud pricing.

quote.text: Check out this talk by Kyle Drake that goes more into the details of bandwidth costs
